meta.title: Laser-Induced Fluorescence (LIF)
meta.description: LIF uses tunable narrowband lasers to selectively excite target species, retrieving 2D/3D density and Doppler-broadened velocity distributions with ns resolution and high sensitivity for plasma, thruster plume, and trace-species diagnostics.
page.title: Laser-Induced Fluorescence (LIF)
page.lead: Highly selective, high spatiotemporal resolution optical diagnostics for density, velocity distribution, and temperature.
detail.title: LIF System
detail.tagline: Tunable narrowband laser + high-sensitivity detection for velocity/density
detail.overview: LIF selectively excites target species with a tunable narrowband laser and collects fluorescence to infer density and velocity distribution. High sensitivity and resolution make it ideal for thruster plumes, plasmas, and trace species.
detail.feature1: Strong selectivity to target species, high immunity to interference
detail.feature3: Wavelength scans for Doppler broadening -> VDF/IVDF and temperature
detail.feature4: Detects trace species with ns-level temporal resolution
